probe: MAScope topology triage on the estate's own ledger ($0, on-disk, local models, no paid dispatch): hand-label a 30-row seed from memory/workflows/REGISTRY.jsonl (FAIL rows plus matched PASS controls; checks[] desc text carries 813-1516 bytes per row, measured) with topology (hub/mesh/layered/shared-pool from script bytes) and failure class (verification-misalignment / coordination-stall / information-loss / semantic-drift from checks desc); zero/few-shot the local free lane (gemma:2b or gemma4, sensing) to label the rest; chi2-test topology x failure-class. Thresholds pre-registered in the card before labeling. PASS (both): cheap judge beats hand labels at Cohen's kappa > 0.4 (the estate's version of gpt-mini-at-6%-cost) AND hub-shaped rows skew toward verification-misalignment at p < 0.05. Falsifier: (a) failing closes topology-conditioned triage as not-our-ledger-shape (triage stays manual); (a) passing with (b) failing still lands the cheap-judge demotion while the topology-duty pairs stay unadopted. Motivating measurement already banked: 10 of 26 FAIL-touching scripts later pass (gate-induced failures self-clear), so the ledger has signal to classify.
